question: The price of a pencil is increased by ₹2 this year and ₹2 in the previous year. The price of a pencil is now 30% more than the price in the previous to the previous year. How much is the price of the pencil now in ₹?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total price increase over two years = ₹2 + ₹2 = ₹4.

This absolute increase of ₹4 equals a 30% increase over the original price.

Current price represents 100% (base) + 30% (increase) = 130%.

Current price = (130 ÷ 30) × 4 = 52 ÷ 3 ≈ 17.33

**∴ The correct answer is ₹17.33.**
